subject: Math
prompt: The monthly rent of an apartment was $$2,000$. The rent increased by $5%$ at the end of the first year. At the end of the second year, the rent increased by $3%$ of the rent at the end of the first year. What was the monthly rent, in dollars, at the end of the second year?
explanation: First, calculate the rent after the first year: $$2{,}000 \times 1.05$ = $$2{,}100$. Then, apply the second increase to this new amount: $$2{,}100 \times 1.03$ = $$2{,}163$. The successive percentage increases multiply: $$2{,}000 \times 1.05 \times 1.03$ = $$2{,}163$.
